label: The NECESSARY_2 classical GOD_4 root, from the Dei Filius root and field (inference)
rule: Projection of the nine and application of the field interpretation at the same witness
meaning: The root of the Dei Filius endpoint has the nine (they are among its attributes) and, by the field interpretation, the primitive field: the old endpoint at the same witness. With deiFiliusRoot this gives a route to the old endpoint in which the sufficiency premise is replaced by the field interpretation, five new bridges and the existing infinite-power premise. Conditional consequence only.
